text: George Berkeley's Alciphron, or The Minute Philosopher, a dialogue defending Christianity, was published in 1732. It was placed on the Index librorum prohibitorum by decree on 20 November 1742 and was still included in the final 1948 edition, probably because of Berkeley's anti-Catholic views, according to the Newcastle University Special Collections blog.
